Since the recall was completed, the vehicle has repeatedly showed unpredictable transitions between the electric motor and gasoline engine, delayed acceleration, loss of expected power, and unusually high engine RPM immediately upon the gasoline engine starting. R-15V602000.text: Electrical interference may cause the hybrid system to switch into fail-safe mode, disabling the gasoline engine, limiting the vehicle's speed to 40 miles per hour and functioning only on battery power.  Once the battery is discharged, the vehicle will stall.
R-15V602000.consequence: A vehicle stall increases the risk of a crash.

R-26V625000.text: A high voltage battery fastener may have been improperly tightened, causing a loss of drive power.
R-26V625000.consequence: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.

R-15V179000.text: If the vehicle goes in to limp home mode, incompatible software between Electric Vehicle Control Unit (EVCU) and Battery Pack Control Module (BPCM) may cause the electric propulsion system to fully shut down.
R-15V179000.consequence: An electric propulsion system shut down will cause a stall-like condition, increasing the risk of a crash.

R-26V582000.text: The battery energy control module software may cause an incorrect state of charge to display in the vehicle, or lead to an increased risk of a high voltage battery fire after repeated DC Fast Charging cycles.
R-26V582000.consequence: An inaccurate state-of-charge reading can lead to an unexpected loss of drive power, increasing the risk of crash. Additionally, a high voltage battery fire increases the risk of injury.

R-18V684000.text: Excessive voltage in the Intelligent Power Module (IPM) within the inverter may cause the hybrid system to shut down, causing the vehicle to stall while being driven.
R-18V684000.consequence: If the hybrid system shuts down unexpectedly, it can increase the risk of a crash.

R-24V572000.text: The software for the powertrain control module may cause an engine stall, which can result in a loss of drive power.

R-25V741000.text: The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.

R-24V871000.text: The incorrect dash wiring harness was installed, which can result in inoperative trailer lighting.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
